statement: Whenever min_diff_in_bst(root) returns a result r, r is the least absolute difference between the values of two distinct nodes of root: there exist distinct nodes u and v of root with |val(u)-val(v)| = r, and for every pair of distinct nodes u and v of root, r <= |val(u)-val(v)|, where val(u) denotes the value stored at node u.
preconditions: root is a binary search tree (for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater), the number n of nodes in root satisfies 2 <= n <= 100, and every node value lies in [0, 100000].

statement: For every root satisfying the preconditions, the call min_diff_in_bst(root) returns a result r (Result.ok r); it does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: root is a binary search tree (for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater), the number n of nodes in root satisfies 2 <= n <= 100, and every node value lies in [0, 100000].

root is a binary search tree (for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater), the number n of nodes in root satisfies 2 <= n <= 100, and every node value lies in [0, 100000].

statement: Let a[0] < a[1] < ... < a[n-1] be all node values of root in strictly increasing order. Whenever min_diff_in_bst(root) returns r, r = min over i with 0 <= i < n-1 of (a[i+1] - a[i]).
preconditions: root is a binary search tree (for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater), the number n of nodes in root satisfies 2 <= n <= 100, and every node value lies in [0, 100000].

statement: Let mn be the minimum node value in root and mx the maximum node value in root. Whenever min_diff_in_bst(root) returns r, r <= mx - mn.
preconditions: root is a binary search tree (for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater), the number n of nodes in root satisfies 2 <= n <= 100, and every node value lies in [0, 100000].

statement: For any two trees root1 and root2 satisfying the preconditions, if the multiset of node values of root1 equals the multiset of node values of root2, then whenever min_diff_in_bst(root1) returns r1 and min_diff_in_bst(root2) returns r2, r1 = r2.
preconditions: root1 and root2 are binary search trees (for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater), each has between 2 and 100 nodes inclusive, and every node value in each tree lies in [0, 100000].

statement: Whenever min_diff_in_bst(root) returns r, for every integer k with 0 <= k <= 100000, r <= k if and only if there exist two distinct nodes u and v of root such that |val(u)-val(v)| <= k, where val(u) denotes the value stored at node u.
preconditions: root is a binary search tree (for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly less than the node's value and all values in its right subtree are strictly greater), the number n of nodes in root satisfies 2 <= n <= 100, and every node value lies in [0, 100000].

statement: Whenever min_diff_in_bst(root) returns r and min_diff_in_bst(root_c) returns r_c, r = r_c.
preconditions: root is a binary search tree with between 2 and 100 nodes inclusive and all node values in [0, 100000]; c is an integer such that v+c lies in [0, 100000] for every node value v of root; root_c is the tree obtained from root by replacing every node value v with v+c while keeping the same left/right shape.
